form.label: Sycope NPM - Geographic Distribution
form.description: Geographic distribution of security alert activity based on IP geolocation

search.query: `sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $ip_direction$=* | iplocation $ip_direction$ | where isnotnull(Country) | stats count AS alert_count by Country | geom geo_countries featureIdField=Country

`sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $ip_direction$=* | iplocation $ip_direction$ | eval geo_country = coalesce(Country, dest_country, src_country) | where isnotnull(geo_country) | stats count AS alert_count by geo_country | sort - alert_count | head 20

`sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $ip_direction$=* | iplocation $ip_direction$ | eval geo_country = coalesce(Country, dest_country, src_country) | where isnotnull(geo_country) | stats count AS alert_count, dc($ip_direction$) AS unique_ips, dc(alert_name) AS alert_types, values(severity) AS severities, latest(_time) AS last_seen by geo_country | sort - alert_count | eval last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename geo_country AS "Country", alert_count AS "Alerts", unique_ips AS "Unique IPs", alert_types AS "Alert Types", severities AS "Severities", last_seen AS "Last Seen"

`sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $ip_direction$=* | iplocation $ip_direction$ | eval has_geo = if(isnotnull(Country) OR isnotnull(dest_country) OR isnotnull(src_country), "With Geo Data", "Without Geo Data") | stats count by has_geo

`sycope_index` $severity_filter$ $ip_direction$=* | iplocation $ip_direction$ | where isnotnull(City) | stats count AS alert_count, dc($ip_direction$) AS unique_ips by Country, City | sort - alert_count | head 15 | rename Country AS "Country", City AS "City", alert_count AS "Alerts", unique_ips AS "Unique IPs"
